Harbour lights report

The red lantern marks the north jetty, the blue lantern the fishing pier and the green lantern the channel into the inner basin.

Night watch

Keepers log a bright orange flare when a boat is overdue, a purple flag when the tide table changes and plain black ink for everything else.

 White on charcoal   Black on yellow   White on blue 

Entries are copied from the harbour office ledger every Friday.
